## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 3 авг. 2026 г. - 22 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Bib Basters_, 22 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "1 minute in the app and I have already hit a paywall. switched to other app"
            2. _Anthony Taylor_, 3 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I chose Habitify and prepaid for a full year of Premium because it showed an overall daily completion score across my habits and categories. After the update, weekly and monthly habits no longer count, so my score shows 0%. Support confirmed this is intentional. Removing the main feature customers paid for during an active annual subscription is ridiculous and deeply disappointing. Unless it is restored, I will cancel and switch apps."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 10 мар. 2026 г. - 4 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Cristhian_, 2 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "Do not buy the premium version. The tracking metrics are defective. Data fails to sync between the Android app and web dashboard, making stats unreliable. I reported this bug within their 7 day money back guarantee. Support refused my refund, claiming it only applies to website purchases, a loophole missing from their terms. They refuse to use Google Developer tools to refund Play Store buyers and expect customers to be free tech support. Save your money."
            2. _Alexander Husted_, 10 мар. 2026 г., 1/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15"
            3. _Chiranth N_, 4 окт. 2026 г., 3/5: "Requires a very big update the tag team needs to have the watch and test the app that are a lot of bugs the previous day data is still visible for today it doesn't update"
<!--/ir-theme-->
